_readme: Realistic mode's numbers, the server owner's own (DMZ Ultra). Empty: the shipped table stands.
forms: race/group/form (or race/form, any group) -> the form's strength multiplier in realistic mode,
e.g. "saiyan/ssgrades/supersaiyan": 50, "human/buffed": 30. Strike, ki power and defence follow in proportion.
stacks: group/form -> {"times": x} (multiplies the worn form) or {"floor": x, "times": y} (at least x),
caps: race (or default) -> the highest multiplier a form, with its stack, reaches. curve: [[shipped, realistic], ...]
for the forms no table names. Read at server start; DMZ Overhaul's scale is still applied on top.
